ns2:section.sectionText: Instructor Approval Required. OIIR Dialogue Course. Topic: Race/Ethnicity. COURSE DAYS AND TIMES SUBJECT TO CHANGE. For detailed course descriptions or to COMPLETE the online ENROLLMENT APPLICATION at http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203 for authorization to enroll. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email diversityed@illinois.edu. Application Dates: Sep 20, 2010 - Oct 25, 2010; Priority Deadline: Sept. 27, 2010.Meets 20-Oct-10 - 08-Dec-10; Priority Deadline: Sept. 21, 2010.Meets 19-Oct-10 - 07-Dec-10.
